map.游离酸比例 = 1 / (1 + 10^(pH − pKa))；渗透深度指数 =: Free acid fraction = 1 / (1 + 10^(pH − pKa)); penetration depth index = free acid concentration × time × (76/MW) × sensitivity × first-time factor / 100
map.游离酸比例由酸型 pKa 与实测 pH 决定：pKa 取甘醇酸 3.83、乳酸: The free acid fraction is determined by the acid pKa and the measured pH: pKa values are glycolic acid 3.83, lactic acid 3.86, mandelic acid 3.41, salicylic acid 2.97, TCA 0.26 and Jessner 3.0; free acid concentration = input concentration × free acid fraction. The molecular weight factor uses glycolic acid (MW 76) as the 1.0 baseline and the rest scale by 76/MW (lactic 90, mandelic 152, salicylic 138, TCA 163, Jessner 100), the smaller the faster the penetration. A first peel multiplies by 0.7. A larger depth index means a deeper peel, used to choose the acid/concentration/pH combination and estimate the recovery period.
